teaser: The line hits the water and the reel catches before the thought finishes. You are a 22, the number called the Master Builder, paired with an ESTP, the type built to act before it explains itself. Most pairings carry one current; this one carries two at full strength — the pull toward something built to outlast you, and the instinct that would rather test the water than measure it twice. The 22 asks for structures raised over years. The ESTP in you wants the next cast, the next catch, proof today. Neither one backs down easily.
excerpt: The piñata stick leans against the folding table, forgotten, while you organize the next three games before the first one finishes.
